scope: Sunday — games starting after 1:00 PM ET

exclusions.other: All remaining Stage 1 qualifiers excluded because the alternate structure was not materially useful for later final selection. Exclusions were made without current-week context, injuries, matchup, weather, role, or game-script analysis.

records.role: Lead RB but declining designed-carry share (75%→57.7%) and route share (28.6%→15.8%); 15 touches/56 total yards last week.
records.matchup: Seattle has allowed the 3rd-lowest explosive-run rate and 3rd-lowest rushing success rate.
records.read: Historical Core is strong, but current usage trend and elite Seattle run defense materially weaken the 40+ path.

records.role: Veteran WR remains active; 4/5/2 receptions over first three games, 10 targets total and 62.7% season snap share.
records.matchup: Seattle passing game is productive, and Chargers coverage attention is likely concentrated on JSN.
records.env: Lumen Field forecast ~67°F, 3 mph wind, 0% rain.
records.read: Low threshold with strong L12 floor; current usage is modest but 2+ remains well supported.

records.role: Short-area role; 8 catches/101 yards through three games.
records.matchup: Chargers defense has struggled overall and must prioritize JSN.
records.read: 20+ is supported by both historical floor and current-season baseline; lower volatility than higher Kupp yardage bands.

records.role: 27 catches on 35 targets through three games; 8/9/10 catches weekly. Leads NFL in catches/targets/receiving yards.
records.matchup: Chargers explicitly identify JSN as Seattle's unquestioned No.1 target; defense expected to bracket him, but his route/first-down ability remains elite.
records.read: Elite current volume strongly reinforces the 7+ Core despite expected defensive attention.

records.role: 405 yards through three games; 135-yard average, 27 receptions/35 targets.
records.matchup: Chargers must focus coverage on him; Seattle offense still ranks top-10 and JSN has dominated first-down production.
records.read: Current production materially strengthens the already strong 90+ historical Core.

records.role: 627 passing yards through three games (~209/game) but Chargers rank 29th in points and offense has struggled.
records.matchup: Seattle owns a top-ranked defense, including strong pressure/pass-defense metrics.
records.injury: Herbert available; Trey Lance questionable but no indication Herbert is unavailable.
records.env: Clean conditions but difficult road matchup.
records.read: 200+ has historical support, but current offense and Seattle defense create meaningful downside.

records.role: 35 carries through three games; 121 yards total. Denver expected to emphasize heavier personnel/under-center run concepts.
records.matchup: Denver run game has struggled and faces a 49ers defense; SF defensive injuries may help rushing efficiency.
records.env: Hot Santa Clara conditions, ~86°F kickoff, minimal wind.
records.read: Role is secure, but efficiency is the question. Heat may increase workload/rotation considerations.

records.role: 789 yards through three games, 72.3% completion, 9 TD/1 INT; remained highly efficient in Week 3.
records.matchup: Denver defense is strong overall, but SF protection has been excellent and Purdy has not been sacked this season.
records.env: Hot but calm Santa Clara conditions.
records.read: Current efficiency and protection strongly support the 200+ Core.

records.role: 35 carries through three games and remains central to SF's offense as a dual-threat back.
records.matchup: Denver must account for him in multiple formations; SF offensive design consistently uses him as a receiving outlet.
records.read: High-volume role plus healthy status makes 4+ receptions one of the cleaner Core candidates.

records.role: 166 rushing yards on 35 carries through three games; 4.7 YPC and central late-game workload.
records.matchup: Denver's run defense has been inconsistent and SF's OL has graded strongly.
records.read: Current workload and line play support the 60+ Core, though heat adds some late-game uncertainty.

records.role: 12 catches/174 yards through three games; remains a major part of SF passing attack.
records.matchup: SF WR injuries increase the importance of Kittle/other established targets.
records.read: Strong current role plus depleted WR room supports continued Kittle involvement.

records.role: 12 receptions through three games; established chain-moving role.
records.matchup: Mike Evans is questionable and other SF WRs have been injured, potentially concentrating targets.
records.read: 4+ is strongly supported by both historical consistency and current target concentration.

records.role: Only 3.0 targets/game and 28.7 receiving yards/game through three games.
records.matchup: SF presents a disciplined defense and Denver's passing game has been inconsistent.
records.read: The L12 Core is attractive at 30+, but current target volume does not support confidence at the same level.

records.role: Currently a Minnesota WR; only 1 catch for 1 yard on 3 targets through two games. With Justin Jefferson ruled out, Minnesota says Jennings and Jordan Addison will be relied upon more.
records.matchup: Miami is 0-3 and Minnesota is 3-0, but the Vikings offense has struggled and Kyler Murray's passing game has been inconsistent.
records.injury: No listed game-status concern; Jefferson is out, increasing available WR opportunity.
records.env: U.S. Bank Stadium is indoors; outdoor weather is not material.
records.read: Current context is supportive because Jefferson is out, but Jennings' actual 2026 usage remains extremely low, creating a major conflict with the locked historical Core. Treat as Mixed rather than Supportive.

records.role: Currently a Minnesota WR; only 1 catch for 1 yard on 3 targets through two games. With Justin Jefferson ruled out, Minnesota says Jennings and Jordan Addison will be relied upon more.
records.matchup: Miami is 0-3 and Minnesota is 3-0, but the Vikings offense has struggled and Kyler Murray's passing game has been inconsistent.
records.injury: No listed game-status concern; Jefferson is out, increasing available WR opportunity.
records.env: U.S. Bank Stadium is indoors; outdoor weather is not material.
records.read: Current context is supportive because Jefferson is out, but Jennings' actual 2026 usage remains extremely low, creating a major conflict with the locked historical Core. Treat as Mixed rather than Supportive.

records.role: Kansas City enters 3-0 with the league's second-ranked offense according to current previews.
records.matchup: Raiders are also 3-0; game total around 46.5–47.5 and KC favored, supporting sustained offensive volume.
records.read: High-end historical Core aligns with strong current offense and game environment.

records.role: 802 passing yards through three games, 8 TD/0 INT; Detroit has scored 31 points in every game.
records.matchup: Carolina defense presents a favorable environment; Goff has been excellent against blitzes.
records.injury: No QB injury concern; Lions OL interior largely recovered.
records.env: Charlotte outdoor night game; no material weather concern found.
records.read: One of the strongest context/historical combinations on the board.

records.role: High-powered offense but Gibbs and Amon-Ra St. Brown have absorbed much of the production; LaPorta has underperformed relative to expectations.
records.matchup: Carolina has allowed significant yardage, creating opportunity for Detroit passing volume.
records.read: Team environment is supportive, but target competition keeps 4+ from being a clean selection.

records.role: Same target-competition issue; current-season role has been secondary to Gibbs/St. Brown.
records.matchup: Carolina's defense allows opportunities, and Detroit offense has produced consistently.
records.read: 40+ has a solid historical base, but current usage is not strong enough to call fully supportive.
